profile_text.body:
Appian Corp is a public company headquartered in McLean, Virginia, trading under the ticker APPN, with CIK 0001441683. Its site describes it as providing AI automation for critical business processes, orchestrating AI agents, systems, and people on an enterprise platform without replacing existing systems. The company says it has been automating processes for more than 25 years and describes itself as a Leader in Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies (BOAT).

The site lists uses across accounts payable and receivable, invoice processing and reconciliation, sourcing and supplier data, audit workflows and attestations, case intake and resolution, purchase-to-pay, onboarding, order intake and fulfillment, and contract review and approvals. It says onboarding time can be cut by up to 50%. Appian also describes low-code app building with embedded AI agents that extract data, act autonomously, and generate code from natural language prompts. It points to a Gartner assessment of 20 BOAT vendors and an AI value study with Harvard Business Review Analytic Services.

No individual lawsuits are listed for the company. Its law exposure is listed in Virginia, with a count of 152.
